predictions: Oh, hey now!!! My second 20-3 record in the last three weeks!! And of course 2 of my 3 wrong picks were in C… C is the only division in which I'm as low as two-thirds correct (yep, that's right, my very worst division so far is one where I'm still 12-6). This brings me to 105-33 for the season so far (76.1% correct), which is pretty great. I also have a winning record for all but 4 teams leaguewide (and Rippin is just at 0.500 even). Help me out a bit here, Bandits, Bangin, and Bottoms…

Match of the week: (G Div.) The Neighborhood Dart Knights @ Nein Mark. I'm a little stunned that I'm not describing this as a battle of big ol' undefeateds, but week 6 didn't treat the Knights so well. Honestly though, if this goes the way I think it will, that week 6 upset might just set up this pairing as an amazing head-to-head duo of 11-1s fighting for the G title in 7 weeks. And why are they both 11-1? Knights win, 14-10.

Match #2: (A Div.) Ring of Elements @ The Bullies. I know, I know… how the heck can this pair of undefeated RDL legends not be the match of the week? Well, it looks like at least one (and maybe both?) of these teams will be missing a couple key parts. Still a big match, but I think this is a setup for the "real" showdown in week 14 (and 17?). Obviously, these rosters will still have lots of great talent, of course. Bullies in 1001?

Match #3: (B Div.) Darty Minds @ Raging Bulls Eyes. It feels like a hundred years ago that Show Me took Raging out behind the woodshed in week 1. Since that day, these two teams are 10-0 with only one win by fewer than 4 points. Is this the day that Raging ties up the B race? Or the day that Darty opens up a two-match lead on the pack? Darty, 13-11.

Match #4: (D Div.) Reload @ Hump Day! The big winner in this one is Menace, who is guaranteed to have one of their two 4-1 competitors take a loss. It's only 8 points separating the lead trio right now, and these two are only 1 points apart! Hump Day has missed a gun or two a couple times already, but I'm gambling they will show full. Hump, 13-11.

Match #5: (E Div.) Red-eye Rangers @ Sharky's Machine. Death Throw took one on the chin last week (did I read somewhere that would happen?), and now the four-pack of 2-loss teams might smell blood in the water. One of this pair is about to be a 3-loss team. Machine, 13-11.

Match #6: (C Div.) Nine Lives @ Double In Stumble Out. Stumble hasn't lived up to their name even once yet, but the Niners are in their most comfortable element: in the middle of the pack with the talent to upset any leader at any time. Stumble, but not easily, 14-10.

Match #7: (A Div.) Liver Alliance @ Lunatic Fringe. The recently standard pair of teams fighting for the league's #3 slot sit a single point apart so far. With their recent roster changes, I think maybe this one has just barely tipped Fringe's way? Fringe in a tiebreaker.

Match #8: (F Div.) Liquor Possee @ Sofa Kings. The Corks are undefeated and two or more matches ahead of everyone else in F. But in their last five wins, they scored just 12 or 13 in four of them. Just a dart or two and these teams are back in the race. Sofa, 13-11.

Matches #9 & #10: (B Div.) Iceman's @ Dart Attack; Double In, Uber Out @ Trips Are For Kids. The four teams in B that were also in B last season sit in 4th-7th, separated by only 1 match and 20 points across the foursome. And whichever of this four finishes lowest will likely drop to C in the spring. Dart Attack is already a match ahead of the others here, and handle their business, 14-10. And Uber Out barely gets past Trips Are For Kids, by just 13-11.

Match #11: (A Div.) Why So Serious? @ Consistent. Inconsistent. Yep, Inconsistent is winless so far, as is easily seen on page 2. But in those five losses, they've scored 11 three times already! Dangit. It just HAS to be time for them to break through, doesn't it? 13-11.
Match #12: (G Div.) Triple Shot @ 21 Dart Salute. Triple is still in search of their first win as an RDL squad, and might this matchup with the other brand new squad be it? Maybe. But… Salute, 14-10.
And the remaining 11 matches, sorted by division:
B Division: Show Me Your Tips 15, Trippin Bulls 9.
C Division: Darty Sanchez 13, Outlaws 11; Bandits 15, Rif Raf 7.
D Division: Menace 14, McGavin 10; DD-214 14, Cheap Shots 10.
E Division: Death Throw 15, Irish Ton 9; Village Idiots 15, YNTA 9.
F Division: Runs with Corks 16, That's What She Said 8; Dart Side of the Moon 13, Rippin Darts 11; Bangin The Wire 13, Sharks 11.
G Division: The Rock Bottoms 13, We're Sexy & We Throw It 11.
